title: A change sent to a work order invoiced in another tab is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A, ready to invoice.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • Open the same work order in a second tab of the same browser.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, click the Sales Representative field so the dropdown is open.
  2. In the second tab, invoice the work order.
  3. Back in the first tab, without reloading, click sales rep B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The dropdown is open.

Step 2:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 3:

  • The change is refused with the message "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order."
  • The field returns to sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-E4: “Changing a representative after the work order is invoiced or paid is not offered. A change sent by any other route is refused with "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order." The invoice keeps the names captured when it was created (Story 5). Reversing the invoice unlocks the field again, and the next invoice captures the names afresh.”
  • S1-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit', or a work order that is invoiced, paid or opened from its history, shows the field as plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. If a change is sent by any other route, the system refuses it.”
  • User Feedback Summary, a change sent to an invoiced or paid work order: “Error message; the field returns to the saved value”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
